newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to calm down, eye 114-21 on upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to calm down, eye 114-21 on upside.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE will take a breather after their volatile activity of the last two days, but the bias will be to the upside, technical analysts said.

"We've had sterling move up quite a lot and that could give the gilts a little bit of support so we would probably look for them to go up to 114-21, yesterday's high," Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London.
Weaker than expected payrolls data from the U.S. on Thursday rescued gilts from their lows after the market dived in response to the UK budget.
Once above the 114-21 high, gilts would aim for 114-27,31, resistance from old highs, including the previous 114-31 contract high hit on May 9, Celaya said.
"Then you have the high from Wednesday at 115-05," he said. "If you get above there then we'd be looking for the gilt to extend sharply higher up toward the 116-00 area."
Techncial analysts at Chase in London were not so sure.

"Regular chart analysis suggests resistance at 114-21 and provided it remains below this level, intra-day charts risk building a bearish head and shoulder pattern," they said in a research note. This would suggest medium term weakness.
But they said only a drop below 114-04 would target 113-24 again, the low on Thursday.
On daily charts, 114-04 stands out as the top of the previous range, hit on June 25.
Celaya also saw short-term support at 114-04, but he highlighted 113-24 as the major prop.
"Below 113-24, the gilt could have a really good slide down towards 113-10 and 113-the-figure," he said.
Gilts were quoted at 114-18 at 0724 GMT, up 3/32 on the day.
December short sterling futures were at 92.65, up 0.03.
